create_bayesianvarparams: create a BayesianVARParams dataclass with lag order p and phi hyperparameters for Minnesota prior
fit_bayesianvar_model: fit a BayesianVAR model on multivariate time series data using Minnesota prior regularization
predict_bayesianvar_forecast: predict future steps from a fitted BayesianVAR model with optional history inclusion
plot_bayesianvar_forecast: plot the input timeseries and forecast results from a fitted BayesianVAR model
get_bayesianvar_residuals: get training residuals as a DataFrame from a fitted BayesianVAR model
